papers.title: What Are the Costs of Hip Osteoarthritis in the Year Prior to a Total Hip Arthroplasty?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, Columbus, OH

corresponding_authors.name: Thomas J. Scharschmidt
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, Columbus, OH

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅分析髋关节骨关节炎患者在置换手术前的费用，未涉及任何植入物力学或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not quantify femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; no FEA or mechanical testing; purely economic/clinical cost analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估髋关节骨关节炎患者在置换术前一年的医疗费用。
summary_zh.method: 使用保险数据库回顾性分析术前费用构成。
summary_zh.result: 术前费用显著，其中影像学和门诊费用占比较大。
summary_zh.validation: 基于大型保险数据库的描述性统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the healthcare costs incurred by patients with hip osteoarthritis in the year before undergoing total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of a large insurance claims database to assess cost categories and drivers.
summary_en.result: Preoperative costs are substantial, with imaging and outpatient services being major contributors.
summary_en.validation: Descriptive statistical analysis of claims data without biomechanical or experimental validation.

papers.title: From single melt tracks to large components - influence of process parameters and geometry on the Selective Laser Melting process of CuCr1Zr

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铜合金的选区激光熔化工艺参数与几何形状的影响，不涉及生物医学植入物或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies SLM of CuCr1Zr for non-biomedical applications, with no porous structures, no mechanical/fatigue testing, and no osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究CuCr1Zr合金选区激光熔化工艺参数与几何形状的影响
summary_zh.method: 从单道扫描到大尺寸构件实验，变化参数和几何形状
summary_zh.result: 建立了工艺参数与构件质量的关系
summary_zh.validation: 通过单道实验和构件制造验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of process parameters and geometry on the Selective Laser Melting of CuCr1Zr alloy.
summary_en.method: Experimental study from single melt tracks to large components, varying parameters and geometry.
summary_en.result: Correlation between process parameters, geometry, and build quality was established.
summary_en.validation: Validation through single track experiments and full-scale component fabrication.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论口腔种植体的骨整合，未涉及AM生物医用材料、LPBF制造或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no porous structure optimization, and no stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较口腔种植体与天然牙齿的力学和生物学差异
summary_zh.result: 种植体缺乏天然牙齿的周力感受器和缓冲能力
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床观察和文献数据

summary_en.motivation: To compare the biomechanical and biological properties of oral implants with natural teeth.
summary_en.method: A review and comparison of existing clinical and experimental studies.
summary_en.result: Oral implants lack the proprioception and shock absorption of natural teeth.
summary_en.validation: Based on clinical observations and literature data.
